########################################################################
# Setup library
########################################################################
include(GrPlatform) #define LIB_SUFFIX

list(APPEND sidekiq_sources
    sidekiq_tx_impl.cc
    sidekiq_rx_impl.cc
)

# This will run the FindSidekiq.cmake in cmake/Modules directory
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
find_package(Sidekiq)

if (NOT Sidekiq_FOUND)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Sidekiq development files not found...")
endif ()

message(STATUS "Sidekiq_INCLUDE_DIRS - ${Sidekiq_INCLUDE_DIRS}")
message(STATUS "Sidekiq_LIBRARIES - ${Sidekiq_LIBRARIES}")
message(STATUS "OTHER_LIBS - ${OTHER_LIBS}")
message(STATUS "PKGCONFIG_LIBS - ${PKGCONFIG_LIBS}")
# Helpful when debugging Z4 paths:
message(STATUS "Sidekiq_LIB_DIRS - ${Sidekiq_LIB_DIRS}")

include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
include_directories(${Sidekiq_INCLUDE_DIRS})

# Export the list up so python/bindings can decide to build
set(sidekiq_sources "${sidekiq_sources}" PARENT_SCOPE)

if(NOT sidekiq_sources)
    MESSAGE(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif()

add_library(gnuradio-sidekiq SHARED ${sidekiq_sources})

include_directories(sidekiq_sources)

# Keep your original link line
target_link_libraries(gnuradio-sidekiq
    gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime
    ${Sidekiq_LIBRARIES}
    ${OTHER_LIBS}
    glib-2.0
    usb-1.0
)

target_include_directories(gnuradio-sidekiq
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)

# *** Minimal Z4 fixes start here ***

# Ensure ldconfig-friendly symlink chain (prevents .so.1.0.0.0 stragglers)
set_target_properties(gnuradio-sidekiq PROPERTIES
    DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_sidekiq_EXPORTS"
    SOVERSION 1
    VERSION   1.0.0
)

# If the finder exported the SDK support dir (it does for Z4), add it for build-time
# search and embed it in RPATH so runtime can resolve libsidekiq-dev-z4-1.so.* + libgpiod.so
if (DEFINED Sidekiq_LIB_DIRS AND EXISTS "${Sidekiq_LIB_DIRS}")
    link_directories("${Sidekiq_LIB_DIRS}")
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-sidekiq PROPERTIES
        BUILD_RPATH   "${Sidekiq_LIB_DIRS}:$ORIGIN"
        INSTALL_RPATH "${Sidekiq_LIB_DIRS}:$ORIGIN"
    )
endif()

# *** Minimal Z4 fixes end here ***

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-sidekiq PROPERTIES
        INSTALL_NAME_DIR "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib"
    )
endif()

########################################################################
# Install built library files
########################################################################
include(GrMiscUtils)
GR_LIBRARY_FOO(gnuradio-sidekiq)

########################################################################
# Print summary
########################################################################
message(STATUS "Using install prefix: ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
message(STATUS "Building for version: ${VERSION} / ${LIBVER}")

########################################################################
# Build and register unit test
########################################################################
include(GrTest)

# If your unit tests require special include paths, add them here
#include_directories()
# List all files that contain Boost.UTF unit tests here
list(APPEND test_sidekiq_sources
    qa_sidekiq_tx.cc
)
# Anything we need to link to for the unit tests go here
list(APPEND GR_TEST_TARGET_DEPS gnuradio-sidekiq)

if(NOT test_sidekiq_sources)
    MESSAGE(STATUS "No C++ unit tests... skipping")
    return()
endif()
